transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ChatGPT. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've been having severe memory gaps about a traumatic event that happened to me about three weeks ago. I can remember some things, but there are huge chunks of the event that I just can't recall at all. It's like my mind has completely blocked out the details of what happened.
Did the traumatic event happen more than one month ago, or was it within the past month?
It happened within the past month, just about three weeks ago. That is when the event occurred and when I started having these memory gaps.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Posttraumatic Stress Disorder, Acute Stress Disorder], but the traumatic event occurred within the past month (about three weeks ago). That timing makes PTSD unlikely because PTSD requires symptoms persisting beyond one month, so the current candidate is Acute Stress Disorder.
